alibaba-decision-model-sg.author: Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio)
alibaba-decision-model-sg.cost_basis: Cost uses the provider's published list price. Free quotas, free previews and launch credits are not counted. USD 0.042 per million input tokens, output free; 480,609 input tokens over 600 decisions give USD 0.03364263 per 1,000 decisions. The API bills input tokens only and reports no output token count; cost uses input tokens.
alibaba-decision-model-sg.disclosure: Hosted API from Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio), Singapore endpoint, served model decision-model, measured 26 Nov 2026 on the 600-item supplementary set (300 sealed and 300 public items). All 600 requests were answered (HTTP 200).
alibaba-decision-model-sg.endpoint_condition: Vendor-hosted Alibaba Model Studio decision-model API, Singapore endpoint; native probabilities; one question per request; measured on the 600-item supplementary set (300 sealed and 300 public items).
alibaba-decision-model-sg.notes: Hosted API from Alibaba Cloud (Model Studio), Singapore endpoint, measured 26 Nov 2026 on the 600-item supplementary set.

urun-sense.author: uRun
urun-sense.cost_basis: Cost uses the provider's published list price. Free quotas, free previews and launch credits are not counted. USD 0.025 per million input tokens, output free; 310,149 input tokens over 600 decisions (the 3 requests that returned HTTP 502 report no tokens) give USD 0.012922875 per 1,000 decisions.
urun-sense.disclosure: Hosted API from uRun, measured 25 Nov 2026 on the 600-item supplementary set (300 sealed and 300 public items). Measured through the provider's sense-latest model alias. 3 of 600 requests returned HTTP 502; they count as wrong answers and all 600 items remain in the denominator.
urun-sense.endpoint_condition: Vendor-hosted uRun /v1/systemone endpoint; native probabilities; one question per request; measured through the sense-latest model alias on the 600-item supplementary set (300 sealed and 300 public items).
urun-sense.notes: Hosted API from uRun, measured 25 Nov 2026 on the 600-item supplementary set. Measured through the provider's sense-latest model alias.
